exact_source_pin_verification: 7/7 frozen files and exact private proxy postimage match

scope.selected_route: Actual _proxy_completion chooses load_backend/failover url before passing selected_url; helper permits only the existing loopback 8098/8085 route shapes and never substitutes primary for fallback.
scope.cache: Request-local key is selected base, canonical message SHA, actually rendered prompt SHA. Every count round renders anew; different input messages cannot alias solely because rendered text is equal.
scope.unknown: Malformed or incomplete HTTP200, duplicate JSON fields, empty tokens for nonempty prompt, invalid integer IDs, failed endpoints and expired budget return tokens=None, never a character estimate labelled as a token measurement.
scope.bounds: MAX_ROUNDS=2; one slots request plus at most two template/tokenize pairs, <=5 helper HTTP attempts. Cooperative deadline/socket phase timeout only; no hard wall or end-to-end latency guarantee.
scope.protected_content: Latest original question is passed separately. Full user-led history groups are removed; current user/tool/assistant tail is retained. Stable generated contract prefix is retained; ambiguous marker seams retain the whole system message. Input dictionaries are not mutated.
scope.overflow: Known protected-only overflow returns a specific 413. An unmeasured reduced minimum is not assigned a preceding candidate count. Tokenizer unavailability preserves protected input and remains explicitly heuristic.
scope.identity_branch: Existing owner identity predicate and _build_messages branch preserve behavior, with no context-helper import or counting HTTP added.
scope.source_delta: Only _count_msg_tokens, _trim_ctx and _proxy_completion differ at top-level AST; every other top-level node is identical.

cases: Same rendered prompt for distinct message bodies performs fresh tokenize and cannot reuse the old count; third round produces UNKNOWN without a fifth request.

Duplicate prompt keys in HTTP200 produce UNKNOWN after one round; immutable input, exact original question including delimiter text, complete stable prefix and all current assistant/tool/result metadata survive whole-history-group trimming.

author_tests.attribution: Author freeze/test source; not claimed as independent executions.

limits: Counts cover rendered messages before later tool schemas, training/math/typo/emotion enrichments. The existing 1300-token tool reserve is policy, not a measured schema size; exact_final_context_fit remains false.
Backend process/tokenizer generation is not sampled atomically; no cache survives a request.
This review does not assert that all pre-existing builders preserve tool metadata or that downstream provider/context behavior has been measured.
Source-only package: runtime installation, native identity/CAS and post-install QA remain root-coordinated work. No context-window extension or measured server speedup is claimed.
